name: RiPouch™ Modular Velcro Panel
description:
Built from durable, high-quality materials for long-term use
Universal design mounts to campers, vehicle interiors, bed shells, and more
Install with Velcro backing or your own rivets
Sold individually, pouches not included

Introducing the RiPouch™ Modular Velcro Panel, a simple and versatile way to add modular storage anywhere you need it. Available in multiple sizes, each panel is designed to give you a clean, flexible mounting surface for RiPouch™ pouches and other hook-backed gear, making it easy to keep essentials organized, visible, and within reach.
Whether you are outfitting a camper, organizing the inside of a vehicle, adding storage to a bed platform, or creating a gear station in your garage or shop, the RiPouch™ Velcro Panel gives you the freedom to build a setup around your space and your needs. Different panel sizes allow you to choose the right fit for your application, whether you need a compact storage solution for a tighter area or a larger panel for carrying more gear.
Installation is simple and adaptable to the surface you are mounting to. Each panel includes stick-on loop-side Velcro for quick and easy installation on compatible smooth surfaces, while rivets can be used for a more permanent and secure install when needed. That flexibility makes the panel just as useful for temporary setups as it is for long-term builds.
At its core, the RiPouch™ Velcro Panel is about customizable organization. Instead of being locked into a fixed layout, you can attach, swap, and rearrange your pouches as your gear needs change. Use a single panel for a simple setup or combine multiple panels and sizes to create a more complete storage system for your vehicle, camper, trailer, or workspace.

All necessary hardware

name: 2019-2025 Rav4 Door Pillar Decals
description:
RAV4 Door Pillar Decal Kit (Set of 4) – Fits 2019–2025
Elevate Your Exterior. Eliminate Pinstriping.
Dull, scratched, or faded door pillars can make even the cleanest build look tired. Our RAV4 Door Pillar Decals are the easiest way to refresh your vehicle’s profile while adding a layer of durable protection. Designed with our signature Satin Finish, these decals transform those high-touch areas into a sleek, custom focal point. Whether you want a clean blackout look or a rugged topography pattern, these decals provide a precision-fit upgrade that stands up to the elements and hides fingerprints better than factory plastic.
Fits: 2019–2025 Toyota RAV4 (All Trims)

Why You’ll Love Them:


Complete Transformation: This kit includes 4 decals—two pairs for both driver and passenger sides—covering the surface of the front and rear door pillars.


Air Release Technology: Crafted from premium vinyl with micro-air-release channels, ensuring a bubble-free, smooth application even for beginners.


Customizable Style: Choose from our curated colors (like Satin Black or Topo) or go bold with a custom design to match your specific build theme.


Precision Offset: Each decal features a slight offset from the edges to prevent peeling and ensure long-term durability against weather and car washes.


Satin Finish: Our trademark finish provides a high-end look that hides wear and resists glare significantly better than standard factory trim.



📋 Compatibility & Fitment:


Fits: All 2019–2025 Toyota RAV4 models.


Surface Coverage: These are decorative overlays, not OEM replacement parts. They are designed to cover the flat top surface of the pillar and do not wrap down into the window seals or weather stripping.



⚠️ Critical Installation Info:


Dry Install Only: Do not use any liquids (soapy water or "wet" methods) during installation. This vinyl is designed specifically for dry application to ensure the air-release tech works properly.


Surface Prep: Clean the pillars thoroughly with Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) to remove all wax, ceramic coatings, and oils before applying.


Inspection: Please visually inspect all vinyl pieces for defects before removing the backing.


Professional Help: We are not responsible for installation errors. If you aren't confident in the process, your local vinyl shop can easily install these for you in minutes.


[🎥 WATCH THE FULL INSTALLATION VIDEO HERE]



Shipping & Policies:


Lead Time: Fast turnaround! Expect a 2–5 business day window for all prints.


Shipping Protection: 🛡️ Highly Recommended. Shipping can be rough on flat decals. Please add Route Protection at checkout; this covers the full cost of a replacement if your order is lost or damaged in transit.


Cancellations: All sales incur a 10% cancellation fee after 24 hours.


Questions about a custom pattern? Email us at support@tacovinyl.com.

name: RiPouch™ Velcro Bag - Full (8x12")
description:
Clear front window for quick identification
Large zipper pull allows for easy use in all conditions
"Hook"-side fastener along entire back of the pouch to eliminate sag
Sticks to any carpeted material or "loop"-side velcro

The RiPouch line of storage solutions are designed with convenience and versatility in mind, featuring "hook"-side velcro along the entire back of the pouch to allow you to quickly remove the bag and bring the items you need. Clear front windows on the pouch allows you to instantly identify the item you need. 
The RiPouch Velcro Full Bag is not limited to just tools. From kitchen utensils and toiletries to art supplies and camping essentials, these pouches can keep anything organized, accessible, and secure. These storage pouches are great for van campers, Alu-Cab owners, overlanders, and anyone else. Whether you're a handyman, a chef, an adventurer, or simply someone who appreciates an organized space, the RiPouch Full Bag is the perfect companion.

Measuring 13x14.5 inches, these panels offer ample Velcro surface to attach up to three units of RiPouch pouches, ensuring your essentials are always within reach.

The included stick-on loop-side Velcro allows for quick and tool-free installation, offering immediate organization solutions. Whether you choose the convenience of stick-on Velcro or the durability of rivet installation, these panels ensure that your pouches stay firmly in place, ready to hold your essentials. Perfectly sized to fit three units of RiPouch pouches, the panels provide a customizable and efficient storage solution, keeping your gear organized and easily accessible.
Upgrade your Alu-Cab Canopy Camper with the RiPouch™ Rear Door Velcro Panels and experience the convenience of having your essentials right where you need them, whether you're on the road or at your campsite.

name: OEO Angled Roof Rack Light Mount for Diode Dynamics Stage Series LED Rock Light
description:
OEO Angled Roof Rack Light Mount for Diode Dynamics Stage Series LED Rock Light (Single color or RGB). 
Engineered for optimal light positioning on roof-mounted systems, this 3D-printed mount delivers precision angles that maximize beam coverage across varied terrain.
SOLD INDIVIDUALLY
Includes:

1 - Angled Rock Light Mount
2 - 1/4"-20 stainless steel bolts - 2" long

Purpose-built to secure Diode Dynamics Stage Series LED Rock Lights, it integrates seamlessly with many standard roof rack brands and configurations. The durable ASA construction withstands extreme off-road conditions, UV light, and heat, while maintaining structural integrity through repeated off-road abuse. Ideal for expedition vehicles requiring reliable auxiliary lighting solutions that perform in demanding environments.
Utilizes heat set inserts to securely fasten the rock light with the center screw included in the Diode Dynamics Stage Series LED Rock Light kit. 
Featuring countersunk holes behind the rock light, this mount allows the use of existing crossbar mounting bolts on popular roof racks such as Sherpa, Victory 4x4, Prinsu, and other similar racks. We include a set of 2 - 1/4"-20 stainless steel bolts that are 2" long in case the crossbar bolts that come with your rack aren't long enough. (Do not overtighten bolts!)
If using in a different location or on a different rack, you can use the inlcuded 1/4" button head bolts and nuts (not included) to secure to any surface of your choosing. 
30 degree lighting angle.
Wiring channels on all four sides allow versatility for having the wire at the top, sides, or the bottom of the mount.
Rock Lights not included unless specifically selected. Rock lights may ship separately if purchased together.

name: JLU Base Plate System
description:
CargoKits Base Plate System is the foundation to your JLU's storage solutions.  Extrusion tracks in the floor allow gear to be bolted or strapped down using our hardware kits sold separately.  The Base Plate also is perfect for attaching drawer cabinets, and fridge slides as well.  The Base Plate System is sold in three parts, the Cargo Area Base Plate, the 60% Seat Delete Base Plate, and the 40%Seat Delete Base Plate.  The Cargo Area is the heart of the system and is required to add either Rear Seat Delete Base Plate.  Both the 60% and 40% can be installed with the remaining seat installed. 
Standard Features:

Extrusion Tracks in Floor for securing gear
Hatch access for all in floor storage
Side access to Seat Delete Base Plates
No Plywood used in the construction (Stainless Steel, Aluminum, HDPE)
